title: Gate-Efficient Implementation of the Query-Optimal Time-Dependent Hamiltonian Simulation
summary: The query-optimal algorithm of [CGWZ26] for general time-dependent Hamiltonian simulation uses $$ q = O\left( αT + \frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\log\left(e + \log(1/\varepsilon)/(αT) \right)} \right) $$ queries to $\mathrm{HAM\mbox{-}T}$ within $\varepsilon$ error for a Lipschitz-continuous time-dependent Hamiltonian $H(t)$ on $[0,T]$ satisfying $\left\lVert H(t)\right\rVert\leqα$. However, its direct circuit implementation incurs a substantially larger gate overhead.
